content:
The **Nuka Launcher** is an attraction at Nuka-World on Tour in Appalachia. 

The rollercoaster circles around the location. A billboard advertises the attraction. The Nuka Launcher is the site of the Event: Seismic Activity, where players face off against the Ultracite Titan. In its current state, the Nuka Launcher cannot be ridden and is undergoing repair.

The Nuka Launcher appears in *Fallout 76*.
